summary: Fourteen days to the Expo. Ridgeline had 9 trucks double-booked at Reno this morning, and Omar copied their CFO and wants a call before noon. Reno sync errors hit 4.2% overnight. Ranking is merged and going into the scoring API. Picker design is frozen. Harbor QBR is tomorrow.

items.text: Ridgeline reports 9 trucks double-booked at Reno DC this morning, drivers waiting at the gate, third time this quarter. Omar copied Ridgeline's CFO. Renewal Nov 20, health yellow.
Omar wants a call before noon today about the Reno double-bookings. Jordan created TW-134 for the call.
Reno sync errors were 4.2% overnight, all duplicates, same pattern as TW-103 (still todo). Fix ticket TW-133 is owned by Arjun, due today, estimate 4h.
Earlier decision: Smart Slots is the priority until the Nov 4 Expo, and sync errors wait unless they worsen. Overnight Reno errors and the double-bookings are a new development.
Ranking PR #232 was approved by Arjun and merged by Nina (TW-116 done). Arjun is wiring it into the scoring API TW-115, due Oct 28.
Retry queue TW-104 is running in staging (Arjun). Nina has moved the sync-error alert TW-105 to in progress. Both are Sep 28 postmortem follow-ups.
Sam finished Expo demo screens 1 and 2. Screen 3 needs the slot picker build. Coastal's anonymized data from Grace is in hand.
Slot picker design is frozen. Sam agreed to no more design changes after today. Leila says changes after Monday would not make it.
Leila says the booth tablet uses the real slot picker, so it must be stable by next Wednesday (Oct 28). She added TW-135, empty and error states, due Oct 29.
Maya will give Sam the final pricing numbers by Friday. Sam is waiting on them for the printed one-pager.
Booth plan: live demo on the big screen, a tablet station for self-booking, and 'every truck on time' on the back wall. Printed one-pager is the backup.
Pinecrest, needed as the third design partner, wants a live demo before signing. Without it, the goal of 3 live partners is at risk.
Coastal kickoff call is booked for Thursday. Valley is still waiting on data access.
Arjun owes API docs for Coastal and Valley by Oct 26.
Jordan will send Expo invites to the 40-lead list on Friday. Lead list ticket due Oct 28.
Harbor QBR is tomorrow (Oct 22). Jordan's deck is drafted, final numbers tomorrow morning. Maya sent Dana the reliability plan. Renewal Oct 30.
Arjun has backend candidate interviews Thursday and Friday (TW-110). Nina is on call this week.
Maya's October investor update is in progress, due Oct 23.
